'''Hill 461''' was a location on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ruusan/Legends|Ruusan]]. It was about 50 [[kilometer/Legends|klicks]] away south from [[Fort Nowhere]], and southwest from the home of [[Grif Grawley|Grif]] and [[Carole Grawley]].

In [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]], Grif went there to herd his [[gra]] and camped there for the night. There he encountered an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Viper probe droid/Legends|probe droid]], [[PD 4786]].
